name: ephe-motion-studio
description: Local motion films from HTML, CSS and JS sources: a timeline, captions, a brand kit and a render queue that cuts frames to MP4 on this machine.

commands.name: motion-new
commands.description: Create a motion project and write its first sources
commands.template: Create a motion project for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_create_project, then ephe_motion_write_source for the HTML, CSS and JS sources. Name the project id and the revision you wrote.

commands.name: motion-open
commands.description: Open a motion project and read its timeline
commands.template: Open the motion project for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_open_project, then ephe_motion_list_timeline and ephe_motion_inspect_project. Report the revision and the clip count.

commands.name: motion-import
commands.description: Import a local asset into a motion project
commands.template: Import an asset for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_import_asset with the local path, then ephe_motion_list_assets. Name the asset id and its path.

commands.name: motion-templates
commands.description: List the shipped motion source templates
commands.template: List the motion templates for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_inspect_project and name the template ids that fit; leave the project unwritten.

commands.name: motion-assets
commands.description: List the assets a motion project holds
commands.template: List the assets for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_list_assets and name each asset id, its path and its size.

commands.name: motion-render
commands.description: Render a motion project to MP4
commands.template: Render the motion project for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_render, then ephe_motion_wait_render with the render id. Name the MP4 path and its duration.

commands.name: motion-brand
commands.description: Apply a brand kit to a motion project
commands.template: Apply the brand kit for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_apply_brand with the colours, font and logo asset, then ephe_motion_inspect_project. Name the revision.

tools.name: ephe_motion_create_project
tools.description: Create a motion project: one JSON document with scenes, a timeline, captions and a brand kit, written under the plugin state root.

name.description: Title of the film. It is slugged into the project id and stored as the brand name; anything non-empty, the first 48 slug characters are kept.

width.description: Stage width in pixels, 16 to 1920; 1280 when omitted. The preview canvas and every captured frame are this wide.

height.description: Stage height in pixels, 16 to 1920; 720 when omitted.

fps.description: Frames per second, 1 to 60; 30 when omitted. The render captures duration x fps frames and more than 600 of them refuse the render.

duration.description: Film length in seconds, 0.1 to 60; 5 when omitted. Scene 1 spans it and a later render cuts that many frames.

template.description: Starting content. `reveal` seeds three beats and one caption spread over the duration; any other value, or omitting it, starts with no clips and only stores the name.

tools.name: ephe_motion_open_project
tools.description: Read one motion project and its current revision.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters. The answer carries the whole project document and its current revision, which every write names.

tools.name: ephe_motion_list_assets
tools.description: List the assets a motion project holds, with id, path, media type and size.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters. The answer lists the files under the project's assets folder with their size and suffix.

tools.name: ephe_motion_import_asset
tools.description: Copy one local asset into a motion project under its own asset id.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters. The folder that receives the copy.

source_path.description: Absolute path of an existing file on this machine to copy in; a relative path would resolve against the server's working directory, so pass an absolute one. Refused when the file is missing or above 8 MiB.

name.description: Label for the asset, slugged into the asset id beside six random hex characters. The source file's own stem is used when omitted.

expected_revision.description: Optional fence: the 64-hex revision you believe the project is at. When present, a stale value is refused with `revision_conflict` before anything happens. The copy moves the revision either way.

tools.name: ephe_motion_read_source
tools.description: Read one HTML, CSS or JS source of a motion project.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters. The source is read from inside this project only.

path.description: Source file inside the project's `sources` folder, which is the allowed root: a path like `index.html` or `css/main.css`. An absolute path or a `..` segment is refused, and the suffix must be one of .css, .html, .js, .svg, .txt.

expected_revision.description: Optional read fence: the 64-hex revision you believe the project is at. A mismatch refuses the read, so you never edit from text you did not see current.

tools.name: ephe_motion_write_source
tools.description: Write one HTML, CSS or JS source of a motion project. expected_revision is a 64-hex conflict check: a stale revision is refused and nothing is written.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters. The source is written inside this project only.

path.description: Source file inside the project's `sources` folder, which is the allowed root: a path like `index.html` or `css/main.css`. An absolute path or a `..` segment is refused, and the suffix must be one of .css, .html, .js, .svg, .txt.

content.description: The complete new text of the file, replacing what was there. Must be a string; an empty string truncates the source to nothing.

expected_revision.description: The 64-hex revision your last read of this project answered with. Required: a stale value is refused with `revision_conflict` before a byte is written, and the write moves the revision.

tools.name: ephe_motion_inspect_project
tools.description: Summarize a motion project: schema, revision, duration, clip count, caption count, assets and sources.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters. The answer carries stage size, fps, duration, the clip, caption and scene counts, the source and asset paths and the brand kit.

tools.name: ephe_motion_list_timeline
tools.description: List the clips and captions of a motion project in timeline order.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters. The answer carries the clips sorted by start then order, and the captions sorted by start.

tools.name: ephe_motion_trim_clip
tools.description: Trim one clip to a new start and duration, under the revision conflict check.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

clip_id.description: The clip's id as `ephe_motion_list_timeline` answered it. An id the project does not have is refused with `asset_not_found`.

start.description: Where the clip begins, in seconds from the start of the film; 0 to 60.

duration.description: How long the clip runs, in seconds; 0.05 to 60.

expected_revision.description: The 64-hex revision your last read of this project answered with. Required: a stale value is refused with `revision_conflict` before a byte is written, and the write moves the revision.

tools.name: ephe_motion_reorder_clips
tools.description: Reorder the timeline by naming the clip ids in their new order, under the revision conflict check.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

clip_ids.description: Every clip id of the project, each exactly once, in the new play order. A missing, extra or repeated id is refused with `invalid_argument`. Only the order field changes; the clip starts stay where they are.

expected_revision.description: The 64-hex revision your last read of this project answered with. Required: a stale value is refused with `revision_conflict` before a byte is written, and the write moves the revision.

tools.name: ephe_motion_add_caption
tools.description: Add one caption to the timeline, under the revision conflict check.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

text.description: The caption line, drawn in the lower band while its window is open. A blank line is refused.

start.description: When the caption appears, in seconds from the start of the film; 0 to 60.

duration.description: How long the caption stays on screen, in seconds; 0.05 to 60.

expected_revision.description: The 64-hex revision your last read of this project answered with. Required: a stale value is refused with `revision_conflict` before a byte is written, and the write moves the revision.

tools.name: ephe_motion_apply_brand
tools.description: Apply a brand kit (name, colours, font, logo asset) to a motion project, under the revision conflict check.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

brand.description: The brand kit to merge, as an object. Only `name`, `primary`, `secondary`, `font` and `logo_asset_id` are read, and only when they are strings; a key you leave out keeps its current value and any other key is ignored. An empty object is refused.

name.description: Brand name carried with the kit, set from the project title when the project was created.

primary.description: Background colour as a CSS colour such as `#101418`; it fills the stage in the preview and in the render.

secondary.description: Accent colour as a CSS colour such as `#3b82f6`, kept on the kit for the sources that ask for it.

font.description: Font family name the sources can ask for, such as `sans-serif`.

logo_asset_id.description: The asset id of a logo already imported into this project; the kit only stores the id.

expected_revision.description: The 64-hex revision your last read of this project answered with. Required: a stale value is refused with `revision_conflict` before a byte is written, and the write moves the revision.

tools.name: ephe_motion_render
tools.description: Render a motion project to MP4: the sources load in Chromium, frames are captured with Playwright, and ffmpeg cuts them to a video on this machine.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

expected_revision.description: Optional fence: the 64-hex revision you believe the project is at. When present, a stale value is refused with `revision_conflict` before anything happens. A render writes no project field, so it is not required to render.

output_name.description: File name of the MP4, a bare name such as `title-card.mp4` written inside the project's own render folder; a path, or a name that escapes that folder, is refused with `path_escape`. Defaults to `<project_id>.mp4`.

tools.name: ephe_motion_render_status
tools.description: Read the status of one render: pending, running, done, cancelled or failed, with the artifact path when it is done.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

render_id.description: The render id `ephe_motion_render` answered with. The status file under the project's renders folder is read back as it stands.

tools.name: ephe_motion_cancel_render
tools.description: Cancel one pending or running render. A render that already finished is left alone.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

render_id.description: The render id to stop. A render still pending or running is marked cancelled with a timestamp; a finished one is answered as it is.

tools.name: ephe_motion_export_project
tools.description: Export a motion project as a ZIP of its JSON document, sources and assets, under the plugin state root or a folder the user names.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

target_dir.description: Absolute folder the zip is written into; defaults to the `exports` folder under the plugin state. The archive is named `<project_id>-<first 8 of the revision>.zip`, must stay inside this folder, and the project must be under 64 MiB.

tools.name: ephe_motion_wait_render
tools.description: Wait for one render to finish, polling its status until it is done, cancelled or failed, or the timeout passes.

project_id.description: The project id, a lowercase slug of at most 64 characters.

render_id.description: The render id to watch while its status is pending or running.

timeout.description: Seconds to keep polling the status, 0 to 600; 120 when omitted. The status reached by the deadline is answered either way.

changelog: 1.0.0 - Ephe Motion Studio: a local motion project model with HTML, CSS and JS sources, a revision conflict check, captions, a brand kit and a Playwright plus ffmpeg render path.
